clues.title: Landscape: Eswatini’s landscape is known for its green
text: Eswatini’s landscape is known for its **green, wooded hills** and **tall golden grass**.
NOTE: In contrast, Lesotho’s mountains are typically barren, and long grass is not a common sight there.

text: Poles in Eswatini are made of **dark brown wood** and follow a simple design. The insulators are mostly mounted on the side.
NOTE: In Southern Africa, three insulators on the pole are more commonly found in Eswatini.

clues.title: If you see Portuguese text in Eswatini
text: If you see **Portuguese** text in Eswatini, you are most likely in the small town of Lomahasha.
NOTE: This is because of its proximity to Mozambique, where Portuguese is spoken.

clues.title: Landscape: Vibes
text: Eswatini’s landscape is characterized by green, wooded hills and tall golden grass. Poles are made of dark brown wood and have a simple design, with insulators mostly mounted on the side.
You can confirm it's Eswatini by the white back of the Google car, driving on the left, yellow outer lines, and the sun in the north. The only other countries in Africa with that combination are:
Lesotho (which has bare, treeless mountains)
Botswana (which is super flat)
South Africa (though this is rare, as most of the coverage now is with blue back of the google car).
